wardrobe.description: Which reference sheet to render from. 'none' means no people in frame — a still life or empty room carrying the topic, used for roughly one article in four so the same face does not appear on every cover.

outfit.description: Which look from that wardrobe, chosen to suit the setting: e.g. 'white lab coat over a dark tee' for bench work, 'grey blazer' for a seminar, 'oatmeal knit sweater' for evening reading, 'field shirt and hiking boots' outdoors, 'olive tank' for training. Empty when wardrobe is 'none'

scene_description.description: What is happening in the photograph, tied to the article topic (2-3 sentences)

background.description: Setting: lab bench, office desk, library, clinic corridor, seafront path, home kitchen. Include the environmental details that make it a real room rather than a backdrop

pose.description: Shot type (WIDE / MEDIUM / CLOSE) plus the one clear action and how the hands are occupied. Empty when wardrobe is 'none'

expression.description: What her face is doing, in plain words: absorbed, unconvinced, quietly amused, tired, listening, caught out, thinking with a hand at her chin, openly laughing. Pick the one the article's tone actually calls for rather than defaulting to concentration. Empty when wardrobe is 'none'

props.description: 1-3 physical objects relevant to the topic, none carrying readable text, numbers, labels or screens

color_notes.description: How the neutral palette leans for this scene: cool and clinical, warm and domestic, grey and overcast
